parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically found in small cooling fans.
parts.Functional_description: It generates airflow by rotating at high speed when powered, moving air through the fan housing for cooling or ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when the motor is activated, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer casing or base body of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and housing for the fan blades.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and directing airflow through the fan assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as a fixed support structure for the rotating fan blades.
